newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares set for more big rises on Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares set for more big rises on Greenspan.

text.p: Danish share prices rose steeply at Wednesday's opening, fuelled by U.S. Fed Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's positive report and dealers predicted further solid increases during the day ahead.
"The top-20 KFX could well climb 1.5 percent today on the Greenspan-inspired Wall Street advances," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 3.39 point or 1.78 percent to 193.98 at 0720 GMT, having closed 2.03 point higher on Tuesday.
